description: This file implements an optimization pass for PyTorch's JIT compiler that performs alias-sensitive peephole optimizations on computational graphs, focusing on simplifying operations like convolution dimension handling and scalar tensor operations.

classes.name: PeepholeOptimizeAliasSensitiveImpl
classes.description: A class implementing the alias-sensitive peephole optimization logic for PyTorch JIT graphs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the optimization pass on the entire graph.

methods.name: replaceWithIValue
methods.description: Replaces a value in the graph with a constant IValue.

methods.name: isFloatingPoint
methods.description: Checks if a tensor type is a floating point type.

methods.name: runBlock
methods.description: Recursively runs optimization on a block of nodes.

methods.name: tryToReplaceOutputWithInput
methods.description: Attempts to replace an output value with an input value if safe.
